# TypeSafe Jev Decision Studio

> High-speed System One calibrated decision platform powered by TypeSafe Jev (`typesafe/jev-1.13`) via OpenRouter.

TypeSafe Jev Decision Studio is a TypeScript workbench and reference implementation for **TypeSafe Jev** (`typesafe/jev-1.13`), an inference model designed specifically for automated, calibrated System One decisions. Unlike traditional autoregressive LLMs that generate multi-token text to classify data (costing 1–4 seconds with hallucination risks and fragile JSON repairing), Jev evaluates decisions directly at the logprob distribution level in 400–600ms with strict mathematical calibration.

- **Model Identifier**: `typesafe/jev-1.13` (available on [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai))
- **Inference Latency**: 400–600ms (sub-second evaluation)
- **Supported Decision Primitives**: Choice (Multi-class), Noul (Binary with transfer curves), Score (Ordinal rubric)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind CSS, Vitest (100% test coverage)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/Romain-Jochum/typesafe-jev-decision-studio](https://github.com/Romain-Jochum/typesafe-jev-decision-studio)

---

## Core Capabilities & Decision Primitives

### 1. Choice (Multi-Class Categorization)
Evaluates state against an arbitrary list of candidate categories in a single forward pass, returning calibrated probabilities across all candidates and ranking them automatically.
- **Input**: `state` (text, JSON object, or array) + `criteria` map of options.
- **Output**: Winning candidate name, `confidence` score $[0.0, 1.0]$, and complete `rankedOptions` probability distribution.
- **Example Use Cases**: Ticket routing, intent classification, catalog categorization (scales to 95+ options in a single request).

### 2. Noul (Calibrated Binary Probability & Transfer Curves)
Calculates raw conditional probability $p(\text{yes}) \in [0.0, 1.0]$ against a verification instruction, combined with dynamic decision thresholds and 4 mathematical transfer curves:
- **Linear**: $f(p) = p$ (Direct probability mapping)
- **Sigmoid**: $f(p) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-10(p - 0.5)}}$ (Sharpens confident classifications, suppresses ambiguity)
- **Strict**: $f(p) = p^{1.8}$ (Conservative power curve heavily penalizing uncertainty)
- **Permissive**: $f(p) = p^{0.55}$ (Lenient curve boosting edge-case recall)
- **Final Verdict**: Evaluated as $f(p) \ge \text{Threshold}$.

### 3. Score (Ordinal Rubric Rating)
Grades state against an ordered multi-tier rubric (e.g., sentiment, compliance level, code quality) and returns both the discrete level score and the full probability density across every tier.

---

## API Quickstart

### Endpoint: `POST /api/decisions`

Execute a Jev decision query from any client:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/decisions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-or-v1-your-key" \
  -d '{
    "state": "personal organization, daily to-do planner, habit tracker",
    "questions": {
      "category": {
        "type": "choice",
        "instructions": "What is the best category for this self-hosted app?",
        "criteria": {
          "Analytics": null,
          "Calendar & Contacts": null,
          "Task Management & To-do Lists": null,
          "Media Streaming": null
        }
      }
    }
  }'
```

### JSON Response
```json
{
  "model": "typesafe/jev-1.13",
  "latencyMs": 482,
  "answers": {
    "category": {
      "type": "choice",
      "choice": "Task Management & To-do Lists",
      "confidence": 0.998,
      "rankedOptions": [
        { "option": "Task Management & To-do Lists", "probability": 0.998, "percentage": "99.8%", "isWinner": true },
        { "option": "Calendar & Contacts", "probability": 0.001, "percentage": "0.1%", "isWinner": false },
        { "option": "Analytics", "probability": 0.001, "percentage": "0.1%", "isWinner": false },
        { "option": "Media Streaming", "probability": 0.000, "percentage": "0.0%", "isWinner": false }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

---

## Local Development & Setup

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/Romain-Jochum/typesafe-jev-decision-studio.git
cd typesafe-jev-decision-studio

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Set environment
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env to add OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-v1-...

# Run development server
npm run dev

# Run test suite (41 unit & integration tests)
npm test

# Production build
npm run build
```
